actions.title: Establish the governed cloud advancement baseline
actions.objective: Validate the closed cloud action catalog, initialize append-only local state, and bind the loop to repository revision and worktree state.
actions.rationale: A persistent, concurrency-safe baseline is required before recurring agents can select work without duplication.
best_practices: one active claim at a time
acceptance_checks: all action identifiers and semantic fingerprints are unique
the dependency graph is acyclic
every safety invariant remains fail-closed
no provider mutation or credential access occurs

actions.title: Verify hosted GitHub Actions recovery
actions.objective: Observe issue 124 and PR 123 until the exact required head has a successful hosted workflow with real job steps.
actions.rationale: A zero-step hosted failure is not repository evidence and blocks trustworthy admission of every later cloud change.
acceptance_checks: issue 124 is closed when required
the observed run targets the required head SHA
the required workflow and job conclude successfully
the required job contains one or more executed steps

actions.title: Bind and review the source change train
actions.objective: Separate intentional cloud changes into a bounded branch with exact base and head revisions, reviewed scope, rollback, and no unrelated files.
actions.rationale: Cloud delivery must begin from a clean, attributable, reviewable source state.
acceptance_checks: the worktree is clean before claim
the change scope is explicit
direct writes to main remain disabled
required reviewers and checks are declared

actions.title: Prove release-gate and immutable build integrity
actions.objective: Produce a non-root immutable container, pinned build inputs, SBOM, vulnerability results, provenance, and exact-revision release receipts.
actions.rationale: A deployable artifact must be reproducible, inspectable, non-root, and cryptographically bound to reviewed source.
acceptance_checks: the runtime user is non-root
the image is bound to the exact source revision
no unresolved critical or high release finding remains
rollback identifies the prior immutable digest

actions.title: Complete durable PostgreSQL execution
actions.objective: Finish transaction, migration, tenant isolation, idempotency, backup, restore, and recovery behavior for the production PostgreSQL path.
actions.rationale: Durable identity and work execution cannot safely precede proven transactional persistence and recovery.
acceptance_checks: migrations are forward and rollback tested
cross-tenant access fails closed
duplicate execution is prevented
restore meets approved recovery objectives

actions.title: Complete production identity and session controls
actions.objective: Wire production authentication, authorization, durable sessions, tenant administration, workload identity, and revocation without raw token persistence.
actions.rationale: Every human and workload action needs attributable identity, bounded authority, and revocable session ancestry.
acceptance_checks: anonymous and cross-tenant access fail closed
revoked sessions cannot resume
workload identities are least privilege
raw tokens and claims are absent from logs and storage

actions.title: Wire the secret broker and governed connectors
actions.objective: Complete the brokered secret-reference path, connector authorization, idempotency, uncertain-write handling, revocation, and audit receipts.
actions.rationale: Connectors must not gain direct secret access or create duplicate consequential writes.
acceptance_checks: agents cannot directly read raw secrets
changed intent invalidates prior approval
ambiguous writes do not auto-retry
connector access can be fully revoked

actions.title: Complete governed Terraform planning
actions.objective: Validate least-privilege, private-networked, policy-checked Terraform with remote-state, drift, cost, and plan-approval controls while apply remains disabled.
actions.rationale: Infrastructure must be reviewable as an exact plan before any resource mutation is considered.
acceptance_checks: terraform apply remains disabled
public ingress is denied by default
IAM changes are explicit and least privilege
the plan is bound to reviewed source and variables

actions.title: Prepare the isolated staging authorization packet
actions.objective: Prepare the exact isolated staging target, saved-plan, data-boundary, cost, observability, rollback, and single-use authorization packet without contacting or mutating a provider.
actions.rationale: The provider-facing staging action must be fully reviewable before Phase 5 can authorize a bounded mutation.
acceptance_checks: no provider command or mutation is performed
no production or employer data is permitted
the target artifact and plan are immutable
the packet requires Phase 5 before use

actions.title: Execute approved staging and operational assurance
actions.objective: Under one exact Phase 5 staging permit, apply the accepted plan, deploy the immutable digest, and exercise TLS, edge controls, identity, persistence, detection, redaction, alerting, and incident response.
actions.rationale: A running service is not ready until abuse, detection, escalation, and evidence quality are observed.
acceptance_checks: registered operational security checks pass
alerts identify owner and response
logs contain no raw secrets or unnecessary personal data
high and critical findings are resolved

actions.title: Execute approved restore rollback and canary safety
actions.objective: Under an exact Phase 5 exercise permit, perform database restore, deployment rollback, canary health gates, automatic stop conditions, and operator-controlled recovery in isolated staging.
actions.rationale: Cloud continuation is justified by tested recovery, not only successful forward deployment.
acceptance_checks: restore meets approved recovery objectives
rollback returns to the prior healthy digest
canary failure stops continuation
operator approval is required for broader rollout

actions.title: Submit the production deployment packet
actions.objective: Assemble the exact production plan, evidence, residual risks, costs, canary, rollback, restore, and communication scope for Justice Gray Maciocha's Phase 5 decision.
actions.rationale: Production resource mutation and release are consequential external actions and cannot be authorized by the loop.
acceptance_checks: all dependencies have accepted evidence
the exact artifact and infrastructure plan are immutable
no unresolved blocking finding remains
Phase 5 approval is explicit, scoped, current, and attributable
